title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Blackcurrant Aniseed 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Blackcurrant Aniseed delivers a rich and distinctive fusion of deep, juicy Blackcurrant with the bold, aromatic warmth of Aniseed. The sweet and tart fruitiness of Blackcurrant is balanced by the spiced, liquorice-like undertones of Aniseed, creating a richly layered and intensely satisfying vape. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides fast-acting nicotine satisfaction with a consistently smooth throat hit. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio enhances flavour clarity while ensuring discreet vapour production, making it an excellent choice for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, offering familiar and satisfying flavours in a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
